items.quote: Vemon Ashington headed service-level targets for frontline operations, setting priorities for several teams.
He set the direction for engagement with industry stakeholders across the public service.
Vemon set the direction for the redesign of the citizen journey for permits across the public service.
Vemon Ashington delivered his share of the migration of core services to the cloud reliably.
He led trialling a fresh approach to permit queues across the department.
Vemon Ashington drove the scenario planning exercise on future workforce needs for the whole division.
